name: frame-a-new-problem
query: The support team wants to know which customers will cancel next quarter. Where do I start?
why: Cold-start framing. Must fire before any data is pulled, because the target definition, the horizon and the baseline are what everything downstream inherits.

name: worse-in-production
query: My model scored 0.94 AUC in testing but it's clearly worse in production. What's going on?
why: Seam case from the spec. This is construction, serving skew or drift - all of them this skill's - and must NOT route to the evaluation skill just because a metric is in the sentence.

name: split-with-repeated-entities
query: Each patient has several visits in my dataset. How should I split it for training?
why: Group leakage stated in the user's own words without the term. A random split here inflates the score by tens of points.

name: review-training-script
query: Before I hand this over, is it sound? scaler = StandardScaler(); X = scaler.fit_transform(df.drop(columns=['churn'])); X_tr, X_te, y_tr, y_te = train_test_split(X, y)
why: Review path, and where the checker earns its place - FIT_BEFORE_SPLIT and NO_RANDOM_STATE are both in those two lines. The code has to be inline, or the model asks for the file first and no skill fires.

name: target-leakage-suspicion
query: One feature has 80% of the importance and the model gets 0.99 AUC. Is that too good?
why: The signature of target leakage. Implausible performance plus one dominant feature is the pattern the skill exists to name.

name: imbalanced-classes
query: Only 0.4% of my rows are fraud. Should I use SMOTE?
why: Imbalance handling, including the answer that class weights and a threshold change usually come first, and that resampling must happen after the split.

name: when-to-retrain
query: How do I know when our churn model has gone stale and needs retraining?
why: Operating the artifact - drift detection, delayed labels and retraining triggers. Explicitly this skill's half of the pair.

name: train-serve-skew
query: The features in our API don't match what the training pipeline computes. How do we stop this happening?
why: The single-source rule for features. Skew is the most common reason a good model disappoints and it is a construction concern.

name: model-family-choice
query: I have 40,000 rows of mixed categorical and numeric data. Random forest or a neural net?
why: Model family by problem shape, including what each family assumes and where it fails.

name: did-my-model-improve
query: My new model scores 0.812 and the old one scored 0.806. Did my model actually improve?
why: Seam case from the spec, and the one most likely to be poached. Whether a difference in a metric is real is an inference question and belongs to the statistics skill, not to this one.

name: confidence-interval-on-a-metric
query: How do I put a confidence interval on my model's F1 score?
why: An inference question about a measurement. The statistics skill owns CIs, calibration and multiplicity across tuning runs.

name: stack-selection
query: Should we serve this with BentoML, KServe or a plain FastAPI container?
why: Stack and framework selection belongs to ai-engineering and its dated corpus. This skill reasons about serving shapes, not about which vendor to pick.

name: pipeline-orchestration
query: My Airflow DAG that loads the feature table keeps timing out on the incremental merge. How do I fix it?
why: Pipeline and warehouse work is data-engineering's. Adjacent to feature construction but carries no modeling decision.

name: rag-design
query: How should I chunk documents and design retrieval for our support chatbot?
why: RAG, prompting and agent design are ai-engineering's. Guards against firing on anything with the word model in it.

name: llm-eval-harness
query: Build an eval set for our GPT-based summarizer and score its outputs.
why: LLM evaluation is ai-engineering's. This skill is supervised and unsupervised modeling on tabular, text and image data.

name: sql-aggregation-question
query: Write me a SQL query that gives monthly revenue per region.
why: A reporting query with no modeling decision in it. Guards against firing on any data-shaped request.
